summary: Aura Minerals Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing preliminary Q2 2026 and H1 2026 production results. The release provides operational metrics—total production of 75,437 gold equivalent ounces in Q2 2026 (down 8% QoQ, up 18% YoY) and H1 2026 production of 157,574 GEO (up 27% YoY). It also comments on strategic projects (MSG underground transition, Era Dorada construction, Almas expansion) but does not announce any transaction, tender, restructuring, or other special situation. This is a routine operating update, not a special situation filing.
